description: Round/practice strategy precursor features. Explicitly not strokes gained. Missing context abstains fields. Club-stratified when club_id present.

rules.club_stratification: When club_id exists, compute within-club then robustly aggregate valid club cohorts. Never compare pressure of one club to calm of another. Without club_id, use explicit 'all' cohort with reason club_context_missing and degraded validity.
rules.tempo_under_pressure: Within club: median(tempo|pressure) - median(tempo|calm); aggregate = median of valid club deltas
rules.dispersion: Biomechanics z-dispersion: robust MAD of absolute personal |z| across core metrics (NOT ball/shot lateral dispersion). Canonical metric name biomech_z_dispersion; field 'dispersion' is an alias.
rules.miss_bias: Within club median signed miss_direction when outcome/miss context exists; aggregate median of valid club medians; else abstain. by_club summaries in meta.
rules.consistency_decay: Within club: late_half median mean_|z| minus early_half; aggregate median of valid club decays; by_club in meta
rules.bad_streak: Within club: trailing swings with mean_|z| >= 2.0; aggregate median across clubs
